title: Document
description: A federal regulatory document such as a Notice, Rule, Proposed Rule, or Supporting Material as returned by the Regulations.gov API.

agencyId.description: The acronym used to abbreviate the name of the agency associated with the document.

commentEndDate.description: The date that closes the period when public comments may be submitted on the document.

commentStartDate.description: The date that begins the period when public comments may be submitted on the document.

docketId.description: The ID of the docket to which the document corresponds.

frDocNum.description: The federal register document number of the document.

highlightedContent.description: Content highlighted by search engine for the searchTerm. Only returned for searches with searchTerm.

lastModifiedDate.description: The date document was last modified in the system.

objectId.description: The internal ID of the document in our system.

openForComment.description: Conveys if the document is open for comment.

postedDate.description: The date that the document was posted by the agency to the system.

subtype.description: An agency-specific attribute to further categorize a document beyond the documentType.

title.description: The formal title of the document.

withdrawn.description: Conveys if the document is withdrawn.
